limitations: This is a narrow source-delta review only. It is not a fresh full RC, an official verifier run, CI, or readiness approval for the changed tree. The final tree still requires the original RC, an independent official verifier, all required green CI, and normal merge with main exact-tree verification. CI and verifier run outcomes (39674482673, 39674634207) were taken from the preserved report files, not re-fetched from GitHub. The native inventory sensor was not re-run; only the generated bodies already on disk were re-checked. C6 protocol material was not opened, reviewed or executed. C6 status (blocked, native extra bindings empty) was confirmed only from preserved records and from the fact that no tracked governance files changed. Prior source hashes and metadata are historical and do not represent this candidate.
